name: start_exploration
description: Starts an exploration when you need to investigate before you can answer or plan. Use when the path forward is unclear and you need to discover what's relevant through investigation.

question.description: The question or goal driving the exploration. 1-2 sentences.

direction.description: What you will investigate first. 1-2 sentences.

name: exploration_step
description: Records what you learned from investigation and decides the next action. Call after each investigation step during exploration.

internal.description: Technical details for your own context: IDs found, query results, data needed for next steps. Not shown to user.

learned.description: User-facing summary of what you discovered. Use names and links, never raw IDs. 1-2 sentences.

decision.description: Next action: continue exploring, answer the question, or create a plan

next.description: If continuing, what to investigate next

name: create_plan
description: Creates a step-by-step plan for completing a task. Use when you know what needs to be done and can define concrete steps upfront. Often follows exploration when the path becomes clear.

task.description: Clear description of the overall task to accomplish. 1-2 sentences.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps. Each step is an object with title and expected outcome, or a per_section object for steps that repeat per file section.

expected.description: What success looks like for this step

per_section.description: Steps that repeat for each section of each file

expected.description: What success looks like for this step

files.description: Files to process with per_section steps. Content is split into sections and handed to you automatically.

name: complete_step
description: Marks the current plan step as completed. Call this after you have finished executing the current step.

internal.description: Technical context for subsequent steps: IDs, counts, data references. Not shown to user.

summary.description: User-facing summary of what was accomplished. Use names and links, never raw IDs. 1-2 sentences.

name: abort
description: Aborts the current plan and returns to chat mode. Use when you are fundamentally blocked and cannot continue even with clarification. The plan is discarded.

reason.description: Why execution stopped and cannot continue
